daily.title: BHP subsidiary class action begins over public holiday work
daily.summary: The class action alleges that a BHP subsidiary did not offer workers a reasonable chance to apply for leave over public holidays.

daily.title: Farmer's legacy lives on in wildflower he discovered before tragic death
daily.summary: Mark Mudie, who was killed while fighting last year's West River bushfire, has been honoured for his discovery of a native wildflower.

daily.title: Houthis advance along Yemeni coast, threaten Saudi oil exports in Red Sea
daily.summary: Iran-aligned Houthis advance along the Yemeni coast as Iranian strikes damage multiple US military aircraft in an escalation on two fronts of the war.

daily.title: NSW premier's top staffer in High Court showdown over arrest powers
daily.summary: James Cullen faced being detained and forced to give evidence before a committee after refusing to attend a parliamentary inquiry over the leaking of confidential minutes.

daily.title: Alleged arsonist charged over 11 fires across northern Tasmania
daily.summary: Authorities have been investigating a spate of fires spanning the region from Ulverstone to Perth in northern Tasmania. They have now charged a man in relation to 11 of them.

daily.title: New pest insect breaches biosecurity and destroys berry crops
daily.summary: Invasive flower thrips, detected in Australia for the first time, are destroying millions of dollars' worth of berry crops. The pest could spread to vegetables and flowers, and increase food prices.

daily.title: Months-long $1m in unpaid rates saga ends with sale of 33 outback homes
daily.summary: Properties owned by an Aboriginal housing corporation caught up in an unpaid-rates saga that left dozens of Mount Isa residents facing an uncertain future are sold.

daily.title: What drove the Tasmanian devil out of northern WA?
daily.summary: Researchers say Tasmanian devils lived alongside humans in WA's arid Pilbara for tens of thousands of years, and the arrival of the dingo may have disrupted that relationship.

daily.title: Jimmy Barnes and Jess Mauboy join ONEFOUR for triple j Phil Collins cover
daily.summary: Aussie legends Jimmy Barnes and Jessica Mauboy made a surprise appearance with Western Sydney drill rap collective ONEFOUR in triple j's Like A Version studio.

daily.title: Live: NFL kick-off approaches as Rams and 49ers meet at the MCG
daily.summary: The National Football League is being played in Australia for the first time, as the LA Rams face the San Francisco 49ers at the MCG. Follow live.

daily.title: Bigger and hungrier: What we know about 25 proposed new data centres
daily.summary: Dozens of approved but yet-to-be-built AI data centre projects will escape the federal government's proposed restrictions around energy and water use because the new rules are not expected to be retrospective.

daily.title: 'Art is central to our political power': 50 years of land rights celebrated in art award
daily.summary: The prestigious Vincent Lingiari Art Award pays tribute to its namesake and acknowledges the intimate link between Aboriginal art and land rights.

daily.title: Country council says four-day week has been a game-changer
daily.summary: Struggling to attract and retain staff, the Shire of Boyup Brook in Western Australia's south says its decision to adopt a four-day work week has helped solve the problem.

daily.title: MATES charity aims to prevent suicide in heavy industries
daily.summary: The Sydney mother has since become a volunteer at her workplace having hundreds of important conversations about mental health in an industry that has the largest share of male suicides.

daily.title: Live: ASX down 1pc as oil passes $US109 and bond yields surge
daily.summary: Australian shares open sharply lower after oil prices and Treasury yield surge, weighing on Wall Street. Follow the day's events on the ABC News live markets blog.

daily.title: Opals knocked out of World Cup as luckless captain's torn ACL confirmed
daily.summary: Without a number of their biggest stars, Australia's Opals are knocked out of the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup in a comprehensive quarterfinal loss to Spain.

daily.title: How this Perth dad keeps Dockers fans pumped up from the top
daily.summary: Anchored to a 42-metre-high platform atop Perth Stadium, guitarist Troy Nababan gets the Freo faithful rocking — but the gig is not for the faint-hearted and comes with one unexpected risk.

daily.title: Ohio grandfather of 16 children living in filth incompetent to stand trial
daily.summary: A man whose 16 grandchildren were discovered living in squalid conditions at a rural southern Ohio home is found mentally incompetent to stand trial.

daily.title: Live: One Nation senator says party has nothing to apologise for over Hastie 'traitor' carton
daily.summary: One Nation senator Sean Bell says his party has nothing to apologise for over a cartoon video that calls Liberal MP Andrew Hastie, a former special Air Service soldier, a "traitor".

daily.title: First home buyer scores historic cottage despite $60,000 higher bid
daily.summary: In a red-hot property market where cash is usually king, Karli Bryant was outbid by $60,000 on a 116-year-old railway cottage. Then the owner read her letter.

daily.title: Mothers settle trespass case over 'distressing' bail checks by NSW Police
daily.summary: Two mothers reach a confidential settlement with the police after alleging that visits to check on their sons amounted to trespass.

daily.title: Feral pigs caught on camera destroying local gardens in greater Darwin
daily.summary: Residents in Darwin's satellite city of Palmerston have sighted wild pigs trotting around in suburbia, destroying their gardens. The local council says they are aware of this issue and are making a plan to "safely and effectively" trap the feral animals.

daily.title: Alice Springs council hopes new strategy will rectify town's bad reputation
daily.summary: Alice Springs Town Council is hoping its "change the narrative" strategy will help address the outback town's bad reputation by telling "the whole story" after content creators recently shed it in negative light.

daily.title: ACT records first death linked to 'highly potent' synthetic opioid
daily.summary: The death of a Canberra woman is the first in the ACT to be linked to a synthetic opioid which is estimated to be at least 100 times stronger than heroin, a coroner has found.

daily.title: Horses hop on steam train for unique ride through Flinders Ranges
daily.summary: A historic steam train and a horse enthusiast have come together for a unique trail ride in the southern Flinders Ranges.

developing.title: Live: ASX falls sharply, oil hits two-month high amid US-Iran strikes
developing.summary: The Australian share market is recording heavy losses after the US launched fresh strikes against Iran, driving oil prices up and contributing to a global bond sell-off. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Four more Australians confirmed safe in Nepal-Tibet flood disaster
developing.summary: Four more Australians have been confirmed safe after the Nepal-Tibet flood, with the number of unaccounted-for Australians revised down to 38. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Iran says US will 'regret' new wave of attacks
developing.summary: The new round of strikes comes after Iran attempted to attack American troops and commercial ships in the region, according to US central command. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Hadley sent text message saying Jones 'needs to be destroyed', court told
developing.summary: Retired 2GB radio host Ray Hadley has resumed giving evidence at Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial.

developing.title: Live: Hadley back in the witness box for a third day, as Jones trial resumes
developing.summary: Ray Hadley returns for a third day to Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial, which has been examining the pair's "tumultuous" relationship.

developing.title: Live: ASX to open higher after sea of green on Wall Street
developing.summary: The ASX is set to open higher after gains on Wall Street. The price of oil is above $US95/barrel as the bond market steadies. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Opposition leader says teachers running 'political agendas' in schools
developing.summary: Angus Taylor would not say whether he agreed with comments from Nationals leader Matt Canavan that there needed to be more male teachers in classrooms. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Hawks on verge of stunning upset as Dockers need a miracle
developing.summary: Fremantle's finals campaign starts with a stern test in the west, taking on Hawthorn in the first qualifying final at Perth Stadium. Follow live.
